records.title: Conversion phase 3: jobs and events (branch conversion, 7bbc672)
records.body: {"commit": "7bbc672", "ci": "run 41229924104 green", "archive": "autosourcarr-0.5.0-phase-3.zip", "archive_sha256": "a3d685aa6a10bc446bebbd5539163df2830904f97a9dcadf9136c75b05dbf4ed", "built": ["JobQueue: 3 workers, High/Normal/Low then oldest, identical queued or running jobs merged, needs-disk one at a time, exclusive alone and holding back new starts at the head, long-running outside worker slots, run limit + average + ETA per type, aging against starvation", "watchdog: no progress for the stall time = error at once, cancel, release after grace (never for exclusive jobs), retry with doubling back-off up to one hour; a cancel wins over a freeze", "StopBackgroundAsync / ResumeBackground for resets and restores", "EventStream: one stream with ids, Last-Event-ID resume, resync after a restart or gap, topic filter, bounded readers, coalesced task/error pulses", "GET /api/v1/events SSE with heartbeat and X-Accel-Buffering: no, verified through nginx 1.24 in CI", "/api/v1 tasks, tasks/clear-history, tasks/{id}/cancel, tasks/{id}/retry-safe, jobs, errors, errors/clear, diagnostics (download now wired)", "database move runs as an exclusive non-cancellable job (202 + task id)", "DueScheduler + CrawlPages port with 0.4.x timestamps", "TaskJournal started with the app (task history survives restarts)", "UI: tasks, errors, diagnostics, safe retry on the generated client; live updates via fetch-streamed SSE with the admin token"], "tests": "954 C# tests, Python suite with only the 27 baseline failures, check-project"}

records.title: Phase 3 verified: load test without starvation, frozen jobs are errors, live updates through nginx
records.body: {"done_when": {"no type starved": "load test keeps the queue full of High work for seconds; all Low and Normal jobs finish (aging)", "frozen jobs become errors": "watchdog test records job-frozen:<type> at detection, retries with back-off; abandoned jobs release their slot", "live updates through nginx": "test starts nginx with default proxy buffering in front of Kestrel; a job event arrives in under 2 s"}, "probe": "954/954", "ci": "conversion 7bbc672 run 41229924104 success", "python": "scripts/ci-pytest.sh: no new failures"}

records.title: Live UI uses one server-sent event stream read with fetch
records.body: {"what": "GET /api/v1/events (text/event-stream) instead of SignalR", "why": ["plan phase 3 names SSE with heartbeat and X-Accel-Buffering", "no extra client library", "fetch can send the X-Admin-Token header, EventSource cannot"], "events carry what changed, the page reloads that part", "resume": "Last-Event-ID; resync when the gap is gone or the server restarted"}

records.title: Independent audit of phase 3 found 10 issues; all fixed or scoped
records.body: {"fixed": ["move job could be cancelled/abandoned while copying: now non-cancellable, exclusive jobs never abandoned, 12 h stall limit", "frozen job retried after a cancel: cancel now wins and is never retried", "new request merged into a dying job: not any more", "no resync after a server restart: ids above the newest now resync; the UI reloads tasks on every reconnect", "reconnect replay overflowed at 256: reader buffer sized to the replay", "events could be delivered out of order: delivered inside the lock", "one freeze counted twice: recorded once", "job keys (paths) in the diagnostics download: removed", "timing-sensitive tests: wider margins"], "scoped": ["stop/resume background work has no caller until resets (phase 8) and restores (phase 12) are ported"], "also": "first CI run failed on Python-suite UI harnesses; the suite now runs locally before every push"}

records.title: Phase 3 items carried into later phases
records.body: {"phases 6-10": "schedule_startup_dedup, schedule_startup_refresh, schedule_entry_refresh_job, schedule_catalog_additional_record_scan, schedule_catalogue_choice, schedule_status_aux_refresh become JobTypes when their work is ported", "phase 6": "repair task projection merged into /api/v1/tasks", "phase 8": "library-monitor safe replay; reset routes call StopBackgroundAsync/ResumeBackground", "phase 9": "import context in the diagnostics download", "phase 12": "restore calls StopBackgroundAsync", "settings": "worker count fixed at 3 (Sonarr); no setting yet"}
